The vendor directly providing the **Yoast** software and services at **yoast.com** is **Yoast B.V.** (or **Yoast BV**).

### Provider Statement & Evidence
* **Yoast Terms & Conditions:** *"These terms & conditions apply to the update and support services provided by Yoast BV of the Netherlands to you as a licensee of any GPL-licensed software provided by Yoast..."*
* **Yoast Shopify Terms & Conditions:** *“As used in these Yoast Shopify Terms & Conditions, ‘we’, ‘us’ and ‘Yoast’ mean Yoast B.V., a company incorporated in the Netherlands and registered under number 55044367.”*
* **Yoast Rights & Trademark Notice:** *“Yoast is a trademark owned by Yoast BV, a Dutch limited liability company.”*
